dataset_audit.missing_value_policy: Reject missing/nonfinite input; no fitted imputation
dataset_audit.relationships: No account, cardholder, merchant, device or geography identifiers exist

feature_meanings.Time: Seconds elapsed from first source transaction; synthetic fixtures use an artificial clock
feature_meanings.Amount: Nonnegative transaction amount; currency is not inferred
feature_meanings.V1-V28: Anonymized components; semantic labels are unavailable

selection_rationale: Highest validation average precision; exact ties prefer lower warm single-prediction p95. Threshold maximizes validation F1. Illustrative costs are not a validated business policy.

inference_latency.measurement: warm predict_proba; one caller; no API, validation or network overhead
inference_latency.batch_input: validation rows, repeated if fewer than 1000; not independent performance data

validation_threshold_analysis.selection_objective: maximum F1; cost illustration does not select the threshold

cost_assumptions.unit: arbitrary illustrative units; not monetary savings
